role: The byte tag: one signed byte, type id 1. Carries booleans, block metadata-ish flags and small enum values throughout the game state.
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests.

members.name: data
members.note: The node holds an int carrying the byte value; the canonical text prefixes it b:.

members.name: toString
members.note: Canonical text b:<n> instead of Java's <n>b.

members.name: copy
members.note: Canonical text round trip preserves the value exactly.

members.name: hashCode
members.note: Only feeds Java's HashMap; the write order is reproduced structurally in nbtbin.c.

members.name: func_150291_c
members.note: a cross-type read: NBTTagCompound.getByte/getShort/getInteger/getLong/getFloat/getDouble (and NBTTagList.func_150309_d/func_150308_e) call it only when the key holds a tag of this type but is read as another; the game reads every key with the type it wrote it (EntityLivingBase.readEntityFromNBT checks HealF/Health's type first) and a survival player writes no NBT of their own (no chat commands in the agent input; anvil, book_editing and sign_editing are off). The same-type getter runs in every recording

notes: The cross-type getters are only reached by NBTTagCompound's typed getters on engine data, which is always well-typed; nbt_int_value reads the b: scalar back as an integer, which covers every conversion this tag can be asked for.
